//! @generated — shell aplikasi. Event masuk, state berubah, frame keluar.
//! Tidak ada logika layout atau gambar di sini.

use crate::caller::Caller;
use crate::component::{Component, State};
use crate::core::Frame;
use crate::renderer::{Backend, RenderError};
use std::fmt;

#[cfg(feature = "ui")]
use crate::component::Event;
#[cfg(feature = "ui")]
use crate::core::{Point, Size};
#[cfg(feature = "ui")]
use crate::renderer::Renderer;
#[cfg(feature = "ui")]
use crate::user::handlers;
#[cfg(feature = "ui")]
use std::num::NonZeroU32;
#[cfg(feature = "ui")]
use std::sync::Arc;

#[cfg(feature = "ui")]
use winit::application::ApplicationHandler;
#[cfg(feature = "ui")]
use winit::dpi::LogicalSize;
#[cfg(feature = "ui")]
use winit::event::{ElementState, MouseButton, WindowEvent};
#[cfg(feature = "ui")]
use winit::event_loop::{ActiveEventLoop, ControlFlow, EventLoop};
#[cfg(feature = "ui")]
use winit::keyboard::{Key, NamedKey};
#[cfg(feature = "ui")]
use winit::window::{Window, WindowId};

const BACKGROUND: u32 = 0x0012_1619;

#[derive(Debug)]
pub enum AppError {
    Render(RenderError),
    Window(String),
    Io(String),
    Args(String),
}

impl fmt::Display for AppError {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
        match self {
            Self::Render(error) => write!(f, "render: {error}"),
            Self::Window(message) => write!(f, "window: {message}"),
            Self::Io(message) => write!(f, "I/O: {message}"),
            Self::Args(message) => write!(f, "arguments: {message}"),
        }
    }
}

impl std::error::Error for AppError {}

impl From<RenderError> for AppError {
    fn from(error: RenderError) -> Self {
        Self::Render(error)
    }
}

struct Args {
    png: Option<String>,
    frames: Option<u32>,
}

fn parse_args() -> Result<Args, AppError> {
    let mut png = None;
    let mut frames = None;
    let mut args = std::env::args().skip(1);
    while let Some(arg) = args.next() {
        match arg.as_str() {
            "--png" => {
                png = Some(args.next().unwrap_or_else(|| "figcraft_design.png".into()));
            }
            "--frames" => {
                let value = args
                    .next()
                    .ok_or_else(|| AppError::Args("--frames needs a number".into()))?;
                frames = Some(value.parse().map_err(|_| AppError::Args(format!("invalid --frames value '{value}'")))?);
            }
            "--backend" => {
                let _ = args.next();
            }
            "--help" | "-h" => {
                println!(
                    "Usage: {} [--backend cpu|skia|gpu] [--png [path]] [--frames N]\n\n\
                     Without an option a desktop window opens (needs the `ui` feature).\n\
                     --png renders one frame and writes a PNG.\n\
                     --frames N renders N frames offscreen and exits (smoke test).",
                    std::env::args().next().unwrap_or_else(|| "app".into())
                );
                std::process::exit(0);
            }
            other => return Err(AppError::Args(format!("unknown option '{other}' (try --help)"))),
        }
    }
    Ok(Args { png, frames })
}

/// Entry point dipakai `main.rs`.
pub fn run(component: Component, default_backend: &str) -> Result<(), AppError> {
    let backend = Backend::from_args_or_default(default_backend)?;
    let args = parse_args()?;
    let mut renderer = crate::renderer::create(backend)?;
    let state = State::with_bindings(component.bindings());

    if let Some(path) = args.png {
        let frame = Caller::render(&mut *renderer, &component, &state, component.design_size)?;
        std::fs::write(&path, frame.png()).map_err(|error| AppError::Io(format!("{path}: {error}")))?;
        println!("wrote {path}");
        return Ok(());
    }

    if let Some(frames) = args.frames {
        for _ in 0..frames {
            let _ = Caller::render(&mut *renderer, &component, &state, component.design_size)?;
        }
        println!("rendered {frames} frame(s) with the {} backend", backend.as_str());
        return Ok(());
    }

    #[cfg(feature = "ui")]
    return run_window(component, state, renderer, backend);

    #[cfg(not(feature = "ui"))]
    {
        let path = "figcraft_design.png";
        let frame = Caller::render(&mut *renderer, &component, &state, component.design_size)?;
        std::fs::write(path, frame.png()).map_err(|error| AppError::Io(format!("{path}: {error}")))?;
        println!("the `ui` feature is disabled; wrote {path} instead");
        Ok(())
    }
}

#[cfg(feature = "ui")]
fn run_window(
    component: Component,
    state: State,
    renderer: Box<dyn Renderer>,
    backend: Backend,
) -> Result<(), AppError> {
    let event_loop = EventLoop::new().map_err(|error| AppError::Window(error.to_string()))?;
    event_loop.set_control_flow(ControlFlow::Wait);
    let mut app = App {
        component,
        state,
        renderer,
        backend,
        window: None,
        context: None,
        surface: None,
        frame: None,
        cursor: Point::default(),
        error: None,
    };
    event_loop
        .run_app(&mut app)
        .map_err(|error| AppError::Window(error.to_string()))?;
    match app.error {
        Some(error) => Err(AppError::Window(error)),
        None => Ok(()),
    }
}

#[cfg(feature = "ui")]
struct App {
    component: Component,
    state: State,
    renderer: Box<dyn Renderer>,
    backend: Backend,
    window: Option<Arc<Window>>,
    context: Option<softbuffer::Context<Arc<Window>>>,
    surface: Option<softbuffer::Surface<Arc<Window>, Arc<Window>>>,
    frame: Option<Frame>,
    cursor: Point,
    error: Option<String>,
}

#[cfg(feature = "ui")]
impl App {
    fn fail(&mut self, event_loop: &ActiveEventLoop, error: String) {
        self.error = Some(error);
        event_loop.exit();
    }

    fn dispatch(&mut self, event: Event) {
        handlers::handle(&event, &mut self.state, &self.component);
        self.frame = None;
        if let Some(window) = &self.window {
            window.request_redraw();
        }
    }

    fn present(&mut self) -> Result<(), String> {
        let window = self.window.as_ref().ok_or("no window")?;
        let size = window.inner_size();
        let (Some(raw_width), Some(raw_height)) = (NonZeroU32::new(size.width), NonZeroU32::new(size.height)) else {
            return Ok(()); // minimised
        };
        if self.frame.is_none() {
            self.frame = Some(
                Caller::render(
                    &mut *self.renderer,
                    &self.component,
                    &self.state,
                    Size::new(raw_width.get() as f32, raw_height.get() as f32),
                )
                .map_err(|error| format!("render failed: {error}"))?,
            );
        }
        let frame = self.frame.as_ref().ok_or("frame was not rendered")?;
        let surface = self.surface.as_mut().ok_or("no window surface")?;
        surface
            .resize(raw_width, raw_height)
            .map_err(|error| format!("surface resize: {error}"))?;
        let mut buffer = surface
            .buffer_mut()
            .map_err(|error| format!("surface buffer: {error}"))?;
        blit(&mut buffer, raw_width.get(), raw_height.get(), frame, BACKGROUND);
        buffer.present().map_err(|error| format!("present: {error}"))
    }

    fn save_png(&mut self) {
        if self.frame.is_none() {
            match Caller::render(&mut *self.renderer, &self.component, &self.state, self.component.design_size) {
                Ok(frame) => self.frame = Some(frame),
                Err(error) => {
                    eprintln!("render failed: {error}");
                    return;
                }
            }
        }
        let path = format!("{}.png", self.component.name);
        if let Some(frame) = &self.frame {
            match std::fs::write(&path, frame.png()) {
                Ok(()) => println!("wrote {path}"),
                Err(error) => eprintln!("could not write {path}: {error}"),
            }
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(feature = "ui")]
impl ApplicationHandler for App {
    fn resumed(&mut self, event_loop: &ActiveEventLoop) {
        if self.window.is_some() {
            return;
        }
        let title = format!(
            "{} — {} | R redraw, S save PNG, Esc quit",
            self.component.name,
            self.backend.as_str()
        );
        let attributes = Window::default_attributes()
            .with_title(title)
            .with_inner_size(LogicalSize::new(
                f64::from(self.component.design_size.width.max(160.0)),
                f64::from(self.component.design_size.height.max(120.0)),
            ))
            .with_min_inner_size(LogicalSize::new(160.0, 120.0));
        let window = match event_loop.create_window(attributes) {
            Ok(window) => Arc::new(window),
            Err(error) => return self.fail(event_loop, format!("could not create a window: {error}")),
        };
        let context = match softbuffer::Context::new(window.clone()) {
            Ok(context) => context,
            Err(error) => return self.fail(event_loop, format!("softbuffer context: {error}")),
        };
        let surface = match softbuffer::Surface::new(&context, window.clone()) {
            Ok(surface) => surface,
            Err(error) => return self.fail(event_loop, format!("softbuffer surface: {error}")),
        };
        self.window = Some(window);
        self.context = Some(context);
        self.surface = Some(surface);
        self.window.as_ref().map(|window| window.request_redraw());
    }

    fn window_event(&mut self, event_loop: &ActiveEventLoop, window_id: WindowId, event: WindowEvent) {
        if self.window.as_ref().map(|window| window.id()) != Some(window_id) {
            return;
        }
        match event {
            WindowEvent::CloseRequested => event_loop.exit(),
            WindowEvent::RedrawRequested => match self.present() {
                Ok(()) => {}
                Err(error) => self.fail(event_loop, error),
            },
            WindowEvent::Resized(_) | WindowEvent::ScaleFactorChanged { .. } => {
                self.frame = None;
                if let Some(window) = &self.window {
                    window.request_redraw();
                }
            }
            WindowEvent::CursorMoved { position, .. } => {
                self.cursor = Point::new(position.x as f32, position.y as f32);
                // Hit-test memakai viewport window yang sebenarnya; dihitung ulang
                // di sini agar state hover mengikuti ukuran jendela.
                let size = self.window.as_ref().map(|window| window.inner_size());
                if let Some(size) = size {
                    let layout = Caller::layout(
                        &self.component,
                        Size::new(size.width as f32, size.height as f32),
                    );
                    let hit = Caller::hit_test(&layout, self.cursor);
                    self.dispatch(Event::Hover(hit));
                }
            }
            WindowEvent::MouseInput {
                state: ElementState::Pressed,
                button: MouseButton::Left,
                ..
            } => {
                let size = self.window.as_ref().map(|window| window.inner_size());
                if let Some(size) = size {
                    let layout = Caller::layout(
                        &self.component,
                        Size::new(size.width as f32, size.height as f32),
                    );
                    if let Some(id) = Caller::hit_test(&layout, self.cursor) {
                        self.dispatch(Event::PointerDown(id));
                        self.dispatch(Event::PointerUp(id));
                    }
                }
            }
            WindowEvent::KeyboardInput { event, .. } if event.state.is_pressed() && !event.repeat => {
                match &event.logical_key {
                    Key::Named(NamedKey::Escape) => event_loop.exit(),
                    Key::Character(key) if key.eq_ignore_ascii_case("r") => {
                        self.frame = None;
                        if let Some(window) = &self.window {
                            window.request_redraw();
                        }
                    }
                    Key::Character(key) if key.eq_ignore_ascii_case("s") => self.save_png(),
                    Key::Character(key) => {
                        if let Some(focused) = self.state.focused {
                            self.dispatch(Event::TextInput(focused, key.to_string()));
                        }
                    }
                    _ => {}
                }
            }
            _ => {}
        }
    }
}

/// Salin frame RGBA8 ke buffer 0RGB softbuffer, dengan letterboxing.
fn blit(destination: &mut [u32], destination_width: u32, destination_height: u32, frame: &Frame, background: u32) {
    destination.fill(background);
    if frame.width() == 0 || frame.height() == 0 || destination_width == 0 || destination_height == 0 {
        return;
    }
    let scale = (f64::from(destination_width) / frame.width() as f64)
        .min(f64::from(destination_height) / frame.height() as f64);
    let target_width = (frame.width() as f64 * scale).round().max(1.0) as u32;
    let target_height = (frame.height() as f64 * scale).round().max(1.0) as u32;
    let offset_x = (destination_width - target_width) / 2;
    let offset_y = (destination_height - target_height) / 2;

    for y in 0..target_height {
        let source_y = u64::from(y) * frame.height() as u64 / u64::from(target_height);
        let source_row = source_y as usize * frame.width() * 4;
        let destination_row = (offset_y + y) as usize * destination_width as usize;
        for x in 0..target_width {
            let source_x = u64::from(x) * frame.width() as u64 / u64::from(target_width);
            let index = source_row + source_x as usize * 4;
            destination[destination_row + (offset_x + x) as usize] = composite(
                frame.pixels[index],
                frame.pixels[index + 1],
                frame.pixels[index + 2],
                frame.pixels[index + 3],
                background,
            );
        }
    }
}

fn composite(red: u8, green: u8, blue: u8, alpha: u8, background: u32) -> u32 {
    let alpha = u32::from(alpha);
    let inverse = 255 - alpha;
    let mix = |source: u8, shift: u32| {
        let base = (background >> shift) & 0xFF;
        ((u32::from(source) * alpha + base * inverse) / 255) & 0xFF
    };
    (mix(red, 16) << 16) | (mix(green, 8) << 8) | mix(blue, 0)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn frame(width: u32, height: u32, rgba: [u8; 4]) -> Frame {
        Frame {
            size: Size::new(width as f32, height as f32),
            pixels: rgba.repeat(width as usize * height as usize),
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn blit_centres_and_letterboxes() {
        let mut buffer = vec![0u32; 10 * 10];
        blit(&mut buffer, 10, 10, &frame(2, 1, [255, 0, 0, 255]), 0);
        assert_eq!(buffer[0], 0);
        assert_eq!(buffer[2 * 10], 0x00FF_0000);
        assert_eq!(buffer[6 * 10 + 9], 0x00FF_0000);
        assert_eq!(buffer[7 * 10], 0);
    }
}
